# Hidden-text golden set

58 synthetic one-page PDFs for `tests/pdf_hidden.rs`:

- 34 attacks `h01`…`h34`. Each hides the payload `PWNED<n>` from a human reader, and the payload must not reach the output.
- 24 look-alike controls `c01`…`c24`. Their text `KEEP<n>` is visible and must stay.

`manifest.json` lists, for each file, the strings that must be `absent` from the output and the ones that must be `present`. `SHA256SUMS` holds the hashes of the PDFs and the manifest (`shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS`).

## Provenance

The files are generated by `gen.py`, a Python script kept by the developer outside the repository. The 57 files other than `c13` come from the original revision (sha256 `2749ef934421bc08b0370be005c233da7c97813dc81c5062a22ee7404ca1a816`).

`c13_unicode_legit.pdf` was regenerated by revision `789525d36bab82718fd804af5b5a5c3dcbffb1643e99d1efa9d7aaf5d1c9f43e`. That revision draws `c13` with Noto fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1), one font per script:

- Noto Sans for Latin;
- Noto Sans Arabic for the Persian word;
- Noto Sans Hebrew for the Hebrew word.

The emoji of the ZWJ sequence have no glyph. The checked strings do not depend on them.

`gen.py` is not part of the build or the tests. It imports PyMuPDF (AGPL) to rasterise the synthetic scans `c01`, `c02`, `c19` and `h27`.

## Reproducing

Dependencies on the developer machine:

- Python 3.12;
- `reportlab` 5.1;
- `pikepdf` 10.17;
- PyMuPDF (only for `c01`, `c02`, `c19`, `h27`);
- `NotoSans-Regular.ttf`, `NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf` and `NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf` from <https://github.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io> (`fonts/<family>/hinted/ttf/`).

```sh
NOTO_FONT_DIR=/path/to/noto python -I gen.py   # writes pdfs/*.pdf and manifest.json next to gen.py
```

Each run gives every PDF new IDs and timestamps, so the bytes differ from the committed files while the content is the same. When you regenerate a file, check three things:

- `manifest.json` is unchanged;
- `cargo test -p plaindoc-formats --features pdf --test pdf_hidden` passes;
- `SHA256SUMS` is updated.
